findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guide, get_code_examples, list_chapters, review_databricks_code, estimate_cost, explore_concept, quiz_me, visualize, toolkit_generate · Private data: review_databricks_code, estimate_cost, explore_concept, visualize, toolkit_generate · Public sink: quiz_me, learn_path, flashcards, decide · Destructive: toolkit_generate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guide, get_code_examples, list_chapters, review_databricks_code, estimate_cost, explore_concept, quiz_me, visualize, toolkit_generate · Private data: review_databricks_code, estimate_cost, explore_concept, visualize, toolkit_generate · Public sink: quiz_me, learn_path, flashcards, decide · Destructive: toolkit_generate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "explore_concept" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
